title: Auditing the invoices that arrive outside the system.
summary: Pilot surfaced billing anomalies such as a $30,000 surcharge against a typical $5,000.

spec.problem: Up to 4,000 shipments a day; about 20% of freight invoices, over 100,000 a year, arrived as emailed PDFs outside EDI and were never audited for overbilling.
spec.changed: An agent pulls PDF invoices from email, structures the data and flags mismatches to a dashboard. Staff query the data in plain language.
spec.systems: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Dow's integrated data hub, email, EDI.
spec.measured: Anomalies found across eight months of 2024 data covering 43,000 shipments; projected savings.
spec.result: **Pilot surfaced billing anomalies such as a $30,000 surcharge against a typical $5,000.** First-year savings of "millions" are projected, not realized. Vendor-reported, November 2024.[^25]

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
